AS PER TERMS OF REFERENCE YARD GRADIENT HAVE BEEN EASED TO THE EXTENT POSSIBLE MAINTAINING GRADIENT AS 1 IN 150 (COMPENSATED).
RAIL LEVEL SHOULD BE 762 MM ABOVE FORMATION LEVEL FOR TRACK STRUCTURE OF 60 KG NEW RAIL ON PSC WIDER SLEEPER (1660 NOS PER KM) WITH 350 MM BALLAST CUSHION.
RULING GRADIENT OF THIS SECTION IS 1 IN 150.
AS PER ENGINEERING CODE, VERTICAL CURVE WILL BE PROVIDED AT SITE WHERE ALGEBRAIC DIFFERENCE BETWEEN TWO GRADES IS EQUAL OR MORE THAN 4MM PER METER OR 0.4%.
LAND TO BE ACQUIRED SHOWN IN DASHED RED.
THE CHAINAGE AND KILOMETERS SHOWN ARE RECKONED FROM CENTER LINE OF STATION BUILDING AS 0.00
THE SECTION IS DESIGNED FOR MAXIMUM SECTIONAL SPEED OF 160 KMPH.
THE PROPOSED FORMATION AND BRIDGES IN THE SECTION IS DESIGNED FOR 25 T-2008 AXLE LOADING.
